headlines.summary_en: Jin10 Data August 10 - National Bureau of Statistics Beijing Survey Team reported August 10 that in July 2026, Beijing's CPI turned to a month-on-month increase from a decline, with year-on-year growth narrowing. Month-on-month, CPI turned from a 0.4% decline last month to a 0.2% increase. Food prices fell 0.6%, with the decline narrowing by 0.6 percentage points from last month. headlines.title: 黄金ETF7月以来揽金超百亿，公募称短期磨底不改长期“黄金牛”
headlines.summary: 经历近半年深度回调，国际金价迎来强势反攻，8月7日伦敦现货黄金再度站上4300美元/盎司，此前一日更是录得下半年最大单日涨幅。伴随价格回暖，资金加速布局国内黄金ETF，7月以来主流产品合计净流入超百亿元，黄金ETF华安更创下连续18个交易日净流入的纪录。回顾此轮行情，金价自年内高点最大回撤超26%，流动性环境变化成为调整主因；在全球央行持续购金的支撑下，机构判断黄金短期或延续磨底，长期牛市基础并未动摇。

headlines.title_en: Gold ETFs attract over 10 billion yuan since July, public funds say short-term bottoming does not change long-term 'gold bull'
headlines.summary_en: After nearly six months of deep correction, international gold prices have staged a strong rebound. On August 7, London spot gold re-stood above $4,300/oz, with the prior day recording the largest single-day gain of H2. With prices recovering, capital has accelerated into domestic gold ETFs, with mainstream products seeing net inflows exceeding 10 billion yuan since July, and Huaan Gold ETF setting a record of 18 consecutive days of net inflows. Looking back at this round, gold prices fell over 26% from their 2026 high, with liquidity environment changes being the main driver; supported by continued global central bank gold purchases, institutions judge gold may continue bottoming short-term, but the long-term bull market foundation remains intact.

headlines.title: 华泰证券：A股超跌反弹仍有演绎空间 重点关注创业板指
headlines.summary: 华泰证券研报表示，上周A股温和放量反弹，风险偏好边际修复，超跌反弹成为主要交易线索，小盘弹性显著强于大盘。展望看，华泰证券认为，超跌反弹仍有演绎空间，重点关注创业板指。节奏上，8月中下旬的中报密集期或是检验反弹成色的窗口。配置上，锚定中报均衡配置。AI硬件的超跌反弹尚可参与，但公募筹码未出清或制约高度，需控制仓位敞口，品种上，首选通信设备。其他的超跌品种中，建议关注能源金属、小金属。7月相对抗跌的品种中，继续关注性价比尚可的非银和CXO龙头。中期视角下，性价比出海链及必需消费处于增配窗口。红利底仓继续持有，结构上，重点配置银行与交运。

headlines.title_en: Huatai Securities: A-shares' oversold rebound still has room to unfold, with a focus on the ChiNext Index
headlines.summary_en: Huatai Securities research report says last week A-shares rebounded moderately on higher volume, risk appetite marginally improved, oversold rebound became the main trading theme, with small-caps showing significantly stronger elasticity than large-caps. Looking ahead, Huatai believes oversold rebounds still have room to play out, with focus on the ChiNext Index. Timing-wise, the mid-August to late-August earnings report peak may be a window to test rebound strength. Allocation-wise, anchor on balanced allocation based on earnings. AI hardware oversold rebounds remain participable, but public fund positions not fully cleared may cap upside, requiring controlling exposure; among instruments, communication equipment is preferred. Among other oversold names, energy metals and minor metals are recommended. Among relatively resilient names in July, continue to watch non-bank financials and CXO leaders with reasonable value. From a medium-term perspective, cost-effective export chains and defensive consumption are in an adding window. Dividend core holdings remain, with structure favoring banks and transportation.

headlines.title: 北交所公司中报密集披露，高景气赛道业绩爆发
headlines.summary: 截至8月7日，北交所共有14家上市公司披露2026年半年报。梳理发现，赛道分化较为明显。新能源汽车及储能带动磷酸铁锂回暖，AI算力与先进封装需求增长较快，成为拉动不少公司业绩增长的核心引擎；而一些传统制造业赛道由于受到全球宏观经济波动、原材料成本传导及出口节奏变化等影响，暂时遇到低谷。（中证报）

headlines.title_en: BSE-listed companies release interim reports intensively, high-prosperity tracks see earnings surge
headlines.summary_en: As of August 7, 14 listed companies on the Beijing Stock Exchange had disclosed 2026 semi-annual reports. Review shows clear sector divergence. New energy vehicles and energy storage boosted lithium iron phosphate recovery, while AI computing power and advanced packaging demand grew rapidly, becoming core engines for many companies' earnings growth; however, some traditional manufacturing sectors hit temporary lows due to global macroeconomic volatility, raw material cost pass-through, and export pace changes. (China Securities Journal)
